jei.draconic_insight.crystal.relay: [Use] Balances energy between linked crystals. Flow changes with their charge levels.
jei.draconic_insight.crystal.direct_io: [Use] Connects one adjacent machine. Input pulls energy from it; Output sends energy to it.
jei.draconic_insight.crystal.wireless: [Use] Connects remote machines. Input pulls energy from targets; Output sends energy to them.
jei.draconic_insight.binder.select: [1 — Select] Sneak-use the first crystal with the Crystal Binder.
jei.draconic_insight.binder.connect: [2 — Connect] Use the second crystal or target machine. Repeat for more links.
jei.draconic_insight.binder.clear: [Clear] Sneak-use the Binder in the air to forget the selected endpoint.
jei.draconic_insight.binder.limits: [Limits] Both endpoints must be in range and each crystal must have a free link or target slot.
jei.draconic_insight.crystal.limits.rela: [Limits] %s • stores %s • %s crystal links • %s-block range • no fixed OP/t rating.
jei.draconic_insight.crystal.limits.dire: [Limits] %s • stores %s • %s crystal links • %s-block range • up to %s adjacent I/O.
jei.draconic_insight.crystal.limits.wire: [Limits] %s • stores %s • %s crystal links • %s remote targets • %s-block range • up to %s per target.
jei.draconic_insight.crystal.setup.relay: [How] Sneak-use one crystal with the Crystal Binder, then use the other crystal. Repeat for each link.
jei.draconic_insight.crystal.setup.direc: [How] Place against a machine. Sneak-use empty-handed to switch mode. Link crystals with the Binder: sneak-use the first, then use the second.
jei.draconic_insight.crystal.setup.wirel: [How] Binder-link it to the crystal network, then bind the wireless crystal and use each target machine. Sneak-use empty-handed to switch mode.
jei.draconic_insight.crystal.live: [Optional check] With Jade's crystal details enabled, point at a placed crystal for current energy, used links, and mode. Recent flow has a separate option.
tooltip.draconic_insight.kind.relay: Binder-link crystals; flow has no fixed OP/t rating.
tooltip.draconic_insight.kind.direct_io: Adjacent I/O: up to %s • sneak-use empty-handed to switch mode.
tooltip.draconic_insight.kind.wireless: %2$s targets • up to %1$s each • Binder-link targets.
tooltip.draconic_insight.binder.connect: Sneak-use first endpoint → use second endpoint
tooltip.draconic_insight.binder.clear: Sneak-use in air: clear selected endpoint
config.jade.plugin_draconic_insight.crys: Disabled by default because Draconic Evolution already shows crystal charge, links, and modes. Enable for Jade formatting; transfer flow remains a separate option.
Show recent link and wireless transfer rates in the crystal Jade overlay. Disabled by default.
book.draconic_insight.name: Draconic Insight
book.draconic_insight.landing: I received a strange mineral from a client. It gives off energy resembling the Ender Dragon's breath, so I will call it Draconium for now. I want to keep a careful record of my research here; perhaps I can find something useful in it.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.core_mark: Place the Energy Core controller at the center, then build the interior and shell around it.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.core_inte: Build the interior around the controller before closing the outer shell.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.core_stab: Add four stabilizers on the horizontal axes, outside the shell and within 15 blocks of the controller.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.core_use: Select the tier in the controller. Follow its build guide or let it assemble materials from your inventory. Once both structure checks pass, activate the core.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.stabilize: The controller is the center of this layout. Keep four stabilizer centers on the axes around it.
For tiers 1–4, one stabilizer block at each of the four positions is enough.
For tiers 5–8, expand each center into a vertical 3×3 plane: 36 stabilizer blocks total.
Keep the plane perpendicular to the line to the core. Check Stabilizers Valid in the controller before activation.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.pylon_pla: With the Energy Core active, place a pylon outside its shell. Leave the core-facing side for the glass block.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.pylon_gla: Attach a full glass block on the core-facing side: Pylon → Glass → Core. Interact with the pylon to form the port.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.pylon_use: Connect energy to the pylon block. Use the sphere to switch input/output; sneak-use the pylon to select another active core.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.fusion_ma: Place the Crafting Core here. Keep its six axial corridors open for injectors.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.fusion_ch: These eight injectors sit three blocks out and one block sideways. Each faces inward along its own clear channel.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.fusion_po: Supply energy to each injector. Put recipe ingredients in the injectors and the catalyst in the core.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.fusion_us: Prepare the recipe ingredients, open the core and start crafting. Check injector tiers, ingredients, power and clear channels before starting.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.reactor_m: Choose an open site well away from your base and valuables, then place the Reactor Core at its center.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.reactor_s: Place an inward-facing Stabilizer on each horizontal axis. The allowed distance is 4–7 blocks; this layout uses four. Keep the channels clear.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.reactor_i: Put the Reactor Energy Injector four blocks ABOVE the core, facing DOWN. Its outer face receives containment energy.
Use a Flux Gate to control containment input. Keep an independent charged backup supply available before startup.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.reactor_o: Take power from a Stabilizer's outer face through a separate Flux Gate. Give containment its own independent supply and keep backup power ready.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.reactor_u: Open a Stabilizer to load fuel, charge containment, then activate. Monitor temperature, field, and saturation. Keep backup power on until shutdown cooling finishes.
draconic_insight.ponder.stabilizers.head: Four stabilizers
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.stabilize: Keep all four centers on the core's axes and within 15 blocks. Check the stabilizers in the controller before activation.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.wireless_: Attach an I/O crystal to your power source and set it to Input. The crystal network can then carry that energy to the wireless crystal.
Hold the Binder and sneak-right-click the wireless crystal to select the starting point for the next links.
Right-click the network's I/O crystal with the Binder to connect the wireless crystal to the supply.
Keep the wireless crystal selected and Binder-right-click the machine's energy input face. For this transfuser, choose its top or bottom.
Put an energy item in the transfuser's Charge slot. Energy reaches the transfuser first, and the transfuser uses it to charge the item.
To draw power from a machine, sneak-right-click the wireless crystal empty-handed to select Input mode. Check that the target's connected face allows extraction.
Basic/Wyvern/Draconic: 16/32/64 receivers, up to 32k/128k/512k OP/t per receiver. Range, stored energy and the machine's input can reduce delivery.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.spawner_v: Right-click a vanilla spawner with a Draconium, Wyvern, Draconic or Chaotic Core to convert it into a Stabilized Spawner of that tier.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.spawner_c: The vanilla spawner becomes a dropped Stabilized Spawner item, keeping its original creature type. Collect it and place it where you need it.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.spawner_p: Place the spawner and check the space around it. Its stored Soul sets the creature type, and redstone controls when it runs.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.spawner_s: Use a filled Soul on the placed spawner to replace its creature type. The Soul is consumed outside creative mode.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.spawner_u: Use another tier's core to change the spawner's tier. Outside creative, the new core is consumed and the old one is returned.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.spawner_s: Turn the lever on to supply a redstone signal and pause spawning. Turn it off to remove the signal and resume operation.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.spawner_c: Before starting, check the Soul, redstone, room and mob limits. Basic needs a player within 24 blocks; Wyvern and higher can run with the player farther away.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.gate_dire: The arrow runs from the rear input to the front output. Connect your fluid or energy lines at these two ends.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.gate_conf: Right-click the gate to set the low rate for signal 0 and the high rate for signal 15. Both entries start at zero; set your rates before starting transfer.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.fluid_gat: At redstone strength 0, the gate uses the low setting: %s mB/t.
Signal 15 selects %s mB/t. Signals 1–14 interpolate between low and high.
Put the gate in your fluid line and let pipes or pumps push or pull the fluid. The gate limits each transfer request; total flow also depends on the pipe network's requests.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.flux_gate: At redstone strength 0, the gate uses the low setting: up to %s RF/t.
Signal 15 selects %s RF/t. Intermediate strengths interpolate between the two configured values.
Connect the supply at the rear and the receiving machine at the front to control energy passing through. Give reactor input and output their own gates for separate adjustment.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.relay_sup: Feed an I/O crystal from your power source, then extend the network toward your machines with relays. Set the source-side I/O crystal to Input mode.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.relay_loa: The relay network feeds an output-mode I/O crystal, which supplies the machine through its energy face.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.relay_bal: Linked crystals can transfer in either direction to balance stored energy. Flow changes with charge levels; the arrows show an example from supply to load.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.relay_lim: Basic/Wyvern/Draconic relays allow 8/16/32 links and 32/64/127-block range. Both endpoints need range and free links; transfer rates vary with network charge levels.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.io_mount: Place the back of the I/O crystal flush against the machine's energy face so the two touch directly.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.io_input: Input mode accepts energy from that adjacent machine into the crystal network. The machine must expose an energy output on the touching face.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.io_networ: Use the Binder to link the source I/O, relay and machine-side I/O in a chain so energy can pass through the crystal network.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.io_output: Link the I/O crystal above the transfuser. Its mounted back touches the transfuser's top energy face.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.io_switch: Sneak-right-click the receiving I/O crystal empty-handed to switch to Output. Use the Binder for endpoint selection and network links.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.io_delive: Output mode sends crystal energy into the adjacent machine. Here it enters the transfuser from above and charges the item in its Charge slot.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.io_limits: Basic/Wyvern/Draconic I/O crystals allow 2/3/4 crystal links. Each serves one touching machine. Check its mounted face, mode, stored energy and network connections before use.
Selecting and linking with the Binder
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.binding_s: Hold the Binder and sneak-right-click the first crystal to select the starting endpoint.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.binding_c: Right-click the second crystal to complete the link. Use this same operation for Relay, I/O and Wireless Crystals.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.binding_u: Keep the original starting point selected and click the linked endpoint again to remove that connection.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.binding_c: To start a new selection, sneak-right-click the Binder in the air to clear its remembered endpoint.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.binding_l: Check both endpoints' range and free link slots. Use the Crystal Network association icon to switch between the different crystal tutorials.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.relay_rou: Link the source I/O, both relays and the output I/O in order to extend the supply route to your machine.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.core_laye: Build the shell from the bottom up: layer %s/%s. Rotate the view to check this layer's outline.
draconic_insight.ponder.shared.core_shel: Check the selected tier and completed shell in the controller. Use the Energy Storage association icon for stabilizer and pylon setup before activation.
draconic_insight.ponder.tag.energy_stora: Follow controllers, tiered shells, stabilizers and pylons through the storage setup.
draconic_insight.ponder.tag.crystal_netw: Start with shared Binder controls, then explore relays, I/O, wireless power and item charging.
draconic_insight.ponder.tag.fusion_craft: Explore the core, injector tiers and crafting setup together.
draconic_insight.ponder.tag.spawning.des: Connect vanilla and stabilized spawners, Souls and tier-changing cores.
draconic_insight.ponder.tag.flow_control: Fluid and Flux Gates share controls and connect to fluid lines or energy equipment.
draconic_insight.ponder.tag.reactor.desc: Explore the core, Stabilizers, Injector and Flux Gates as one setup.
